usage: Pick two or three candidates from this index, then read only those entries in presets.md. Render three title-slide previews and let the user choose by looking. Never ask someone to describe an aesthetic in words.
rules: Always offer three genuinely different previews, not three shades of one idea.
If the output format is PowerPoint or Both, only offer presets where pptx_safe is true.
If the venue is a projector, prefer scheme 'light'. Dark decks wash out.
Never render the preset name, 'Option A', or any workflow label on the slide itself. A preview must look like a real first slide.
A preset is a starting point. Adapt the palette to the user's brand when they have one.

presets.name: Night Ride
presets.tagline: Deep navy canvas, one electric accent, editorial serif against geometric sans.
presets.best_for: Campaign work, product pitches, anything presented on a good screen where a dark deck can be cinematic.
presets.avoid_for: Bad projectors, printed handouts, conservative institutional audiences.

presets.name: Signal Brief
presets.tagline: Warm paper and deep navy, a single antique gold accent, serif throughout.
presets.best_for: Consulting deliverables, board papers, investor updates, policy and academic work. Survives being forwarded.
presets.avoid_for: Anything that should feel fast, playful or informal.

presets.name: Broadsheet
presets.tagline: White page, black type, one red mark. Newspaper structure at slide scale.
presets.best_for: Conference talks, opinion-led decks, launches with a strong point of view. Excellent on a poor projector.
presets.avoid_for: Decks with many charts. The restraint fights dense data.

presets.name: Blueprint
presets.tagline: Cool grey ground, a fine technical grid, monospace labels on humanist body.
presets.best_for: Engineering talks, teaching, technical diligence, research. The grid carries dense information calmly.
presets.avoid_for: Emotional or brand-led work. It reads as clinical.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.tagline: Warm cream, terracotta and clay, humanist type with generous space.
presets.best_for: Brand and campaign work, social impact, culture decks, anything that should feel made by people.
presets.avoid_for: Financial or legal material where warmth undercuts the message.

presets.name: Graphite
presets.tagline: Near-black surface, one hot accent, tight grotesque, ruthless hierarchy.
presets.best_for: Startup pitches, product launches, keynote moments. Big numbers land hard on this ground.
presets.avoid_for: Dense analysis, printed decks, bad projectors.

presets.name: Studio
presets.tagline: Full-bleed colour blocks, oversized type, hard edges, no shadows anywhere.
presets.best_for: Creative reviews, campaign presentations, agency work, culture and internal rallying decks.
presets.avoid_for: Anything sober. The colour blocking is the entire personality.

presets.name: Clinic
presets.tagline: White ground, restrained blue-grey, precise spacing, nothing decorative.
presets.best_for: Internal updates, academic and medical work, regulated industries, any deck where the content must not be upstaged.
presets.avoid_for: Persuasion. It is deliberately quiet and will not carry a pitch.
